sensor.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.
sensor.choice: Use a full-frame 36 by 24 mm capture look with natural tonal transitions; this is a recreation target.

lens.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.
lens.choice: 85 mm full-frame-equivalent portrait lens with gentle optical falloff and minimal visible geometric distortion.
lens.reason: The focal length works with the chosen distance and framing; it is not recovered from an image.

distance.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.
distance.choice: Camera approximately 1.7 metres from the eyes, yielding an intimate head-and-shoulders crop with restrained facial perspective.
distance.reason: Distance sets perspective and is chosen together with crop and lens.

aperture.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.
aperture.choice: Use f/2.8 for moderate subject isolation while retaining believable facial structure and gradual depth transitions.
aperture.reason: A modestly shallow focus effect supports the portrait without demanding both eyes at very different depths be sharp.

focus.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.
focus.choice: Focus precisely on the nearer iris; keep both eyes acceptably resolved by holding the face near parallel to the focal plane, with ears and backdrop softer.
focus.reason: A deliberate choice for this teaching portrait; edit it to suit your own reference and check related settings.

shutter.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.
shutter.choice: Use a proposed 1/160 second still-photo exposure with a stationary subject and no visible motion blur.
shutter.reason: A deliberate choice for this teaching portrait; edit it to suit your own reference and check related settings.

iso.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.
iso.choice: Use a proposed ISO 400 capture look; expose the lit cheek naturally, retain shadow-side texture and avoid clipped skin highlights.
iso.reason: A deliberate choice for this teaching portrait; edit it to suit your own reference and check related settings.

white_balance.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.
white_balance.choice: Set white balance to 4800 K with neutral green-magenta tint, allowing the 5000 K key to read slightly cool before grading.
white_balance.reason: Camera white balance and source temperature are distinct settings; grading is an additional deliberate choice.

key_source.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.
key_source.choice: One 90 cm softbox with diffusion, approximately 1.2 metres from the face, motivated as a broad window-like source.
key_source.reason: A deliberate choice for this teaching portrait; edit it to suit your own reference and check related settings.

key_direction.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.
key_direction.choice: Place the key 45 degrees camera-left and about 30 degrees above eye level, aimed toward the face at roughly 1.2 metres distance.
key_direction.reason: This is a starting placement; the final triangle depends on head and facial geometry.

key_quality.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.
key_quality.choice: Broad, soft-edged illumination with gradual cheek transitions, gentle wrap and visible falloff toward the far shoulder.

key_temperature.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.

pattern.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.

fill.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.
fill.choice: Use a subtle neutral white bounce camera-right with its isolated contribution two stops below the key; retain deep but readable shadows.

rim.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.

catchlights.observation: Teaching example; no reference image was analyzed.
